static_traits.name: Chen Wei
static_traits.educational_background: High school graduate，立志成为音乐Teacher
static_traits.marital_status: 有一个十岁的儿子（婚姻状况Not mentioned）
static_traits.social_status: Has a few friends to talk with, but finds it hard to discuss parenting troubles with them
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；without既往类似心理问题；without既往心理治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性好，能自我Reflection；情绪以紧张与内疚为主；配合度高；语气平和但自责倾向明显

basic_info.main_problem: 常因十岁儿子的安静寡言而自责，认为这是自己为人父not当所致，持续感到内疚与Self-denial，影响亲子关系、睡眠与工作表现。
basic_info.core_demands: 我意识到这种not足感正在影响我和儿子的关系并让我很痛苦，因此寻求咨询；我真的想跨过这种“not够好”的感觉。

core_beliefs: The children's performance reflects and determines whether I am a competent father

special_situations.event: The son is always very quiet at home and rarely initiates communication
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果孩子not主动说话，就说明我作为父亲失败/做错了什么
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Actively arranges various activities and frequently starts conversations to compensate
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他这么安静一定是因为我做得not好，我是个失败的父亲。

special_situations.event: without论工作日还是周末、早晚not同时间，儿子总体都较为沉默
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I were competent enough, my child should be willing to communicate with me in most situations
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly examines himself inwardly, magnifying negative cues and ignoring existing positive interactions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 看吧，他总是not说话，这就证明我have not当好父亲。

special_situations.event: When trying to involve his son in activities, he occasionally participates but is quiet most of the time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他have not明显变得外向健谈，我的努力就have not意义
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: When feeling frustrated, chooses to step back 'give him space' or falls into self-blame

special_situations.event: When thinking about possibly talking with friends about parenting problems or worrying about others' evaluations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人知道我孩子很沉默，就会认定我是not称职的父亲
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids discussing parenting topics with friends, digests alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am terrible，我not配做一个好父亲。

core_conflict.wish: Longs to become a recognized good father and build an intimate, smooth connection with his son
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被证明not称职，从而被儿子疏离或拒绝
defense_goal: Uses self-criticism to push self-improvement to avoid worse outcomes
保持一定距离“给空间”以减少Being rejected的风险

object_relations.object_representation: 沉默、疏离且难以理解的孩子

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor asks about interaction details with the son or points out the self-blame pattern
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 担心自己会被看作not称职，于是将可能对外的失望或愤怒转向自我（对自己更苛责）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气自责、降低自我价值，反复use“都是我not对”“我做得not好”等表述，回避表达对情境或外部因素的not满。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to discuss parenting distress with others (such as friends) or openly express feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes the outside world will evaluate oneself negatively; exposing vulnerability equals shame and risk
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use含糊与简短回应，避免展开个人感受，转向客观事实或结束话题，语气克制。

manifestations: 与儿子沟通少、难以读懂其沉默
Finds it hard to talk with friends about parenting troubles; feels embarrassed and awkward
Ties self-worth heavily to 'whether I am a good father' and whether the child is talkative
将孩子的沉默等同于自身失败
outcomes: Decreased work efficiency与生活幸福感降低

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁自我批评，认为“一切It is all my fault”
与咨询师讨论时小心谨慎，担心被看作not称职

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, and instead does it to the self, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Avoids seeking support from friends, turns energy into self-blame and internal friction
表面给孩子空间，内在把not安与紧张压回自己身上

exception_events.target_problem: 当儿子沉默或not愿交流时，来访者通常会立即将原因归咎于自己，感到内疚并逐渐退开（给孩子空间），导致互动进一步减少。
exception_events.unique_outcome: In an activity arranged by the client, the son participated and cooperated in the interaction, communicating more than before, with a relatively relaxed atmosphere.
exception_events.reason: 线索：not同做法——主动组织具体的共同活动；not同情境——有结构的活动更利于互动，从而出现了与以往not同的交流。

positive_force: Willing to seek help, proactively enters counseling and holds an open attitude toward alternative perspectives
能识do not并描述自身情绪与想法，具备一定自我Reflection能力
曾主动安排亲子活动与对话，愿意尝试not同行动
Has some social support (has a few friends to talk with)
negative_force: Excessive personalization and overgeneralization, tending to attribute the child's silence to oneself
Self-labeling and self-deprecation，Reinforcement“我是糟糕的父亲”的信念
Ashamed to seek help and express vulnerability, limited access to external support
负性情绪与Sleep disturbed，进一步削弱工作与育儿耐心

target_behavior.behavior: Automatically attributes the children's silence to oneself and feels strong guilt
antecedent: 看到儿子安静或not愿沟通
与儿子互动not yet见明显改善
想到他人可能在意自己的育儿表现
target_behavior.core_reason: 对父职的价值条件化信念与认知扭曲（个人化、过度概括、negate正向），以自责来获得可控感与解释感。
target_behavior.function: 逃避not确定感与Anxiety，试图通过自责驱动自我改进以“修复关系”。
target_behavior.consequence: 亲子互动进一步减少、内疚与压力加重，Sleep affected，Decline in work performance。
